transcript.text: I'd like you to make some pictures of our fox mascot, using this attached fox pic as the reference. What I have in mind is three separate square pictures: one of the fox riding a bike in a park, one baking cookies in a kitchen, and one reading under a tree. Please keep the same fox and orange hoodie in all three, and use the same flat cartoon style as the attached pic. I just think it would be lovely to see the mascot doing these everyday things. Please don't put any text in any of the pictures.

Your three square fox pictures are ready. I made each one from your attached fox picture, and asked each time for the same face, orange hoodie, jeans, tail and flat cartoon style, with no text anywhere:
